packrat plan  direct-and-transitive  Rails 8.0.2, Ruby 3.4.2

  SIGNAL      SOURCE          INSTALLED  STEP
  Exceptions  OpenTelemetry              subscribe to Rails.error
  Traces      OpenTelemetry              add the OpenTelemetry gems
  Logs        OpenTelemetry              add the OpenTelemetry logs gems
  Replays     Sentry browser             add the Sentry browser SDK

Add --app service/env to detect if Packrat is receiving data from each signal.
